package main

import (
	"crypto/ed25519"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"github.com/nox-hq/nox-core/slopfeed"
	"github.com/nox-hq/nox-intelligence/internal/domain"
)

func main() {
	seed := sha256.Sum256([]byte("nox mcpfeed consumer test key - not a secret"))
	priv := ed25519.NewKeyFromSeed(seed[:])
	pub := priv.Public().(ed25519.PublicKey)
	f := &domain.MCPFeed{
		Version: "2026.10.26", GeneratedAt: "2026-10-26T05:41:00Z", Source: "osv-mirror",
		Entries: []domain.MCPEntry{
			{Ecosystem: "npm", Package: "mcp-server-x", AdvisoryID: "GHSA-zzzz-0002", Aliases: []string{"CVE-2026-2", "CVE-2026-1"}, Kind: "vulnerability",
				Component: "mcp_server", Basis: "package_name", Rule: "name_tokens:mcp+server", Summary: "Path traversal <script> & more in mcp-server-x",
				Ranges: []domain.MCPRange{{Introduced: "2.0.0", Fixed: "2.1.0"}, {Introduced: "0", Fixed: "1.4.2"}}, Modified: "2026-10-01T00:00:00Z"},
			{Ecosystem: "npm", Package: "@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem", AdvisoryID: "GHSA-aaaa-0001", Aliases: []string{}, Kind: "vulnerability",
				Component: "mcp_sdk", Basis: "package_name", Rule: "scope:@modelcontextprotocol", Summary: "Directory escape",
				Ranges: []domain.MCPRange{{Introduced: "0", Fixed: "2025.7.1"}}},
			{Ecosystem: "PyPI", Package: "mcp-server-git", AdvisoryID: "GHSA-pppp-0003", Aliases: []string{"CVE-2026-3"}, Kind: "vulnerability",
				Component: "mcp_server", Basis: "package_name", Rule: "name_tokens:mcp+server", Summary: "Argument injection",
				Ranges: []domain.MCPRange{{Introduced: "0", LastAffected: "0.6.2"}}},
			{Ecosystem: "PyPI", Package: "some-library", AdvisoryID: "GHSA-tttt-0004", Aliases: []string{}, Kind: "vulnerability",
				Component: "mcp_in_advisory_text", Basis: "advisory_text", Rule: "text:\"model context protocol\"", Summary: "Library used by MCP servers",
				Ranges: []domain.MCPRange{{Introduced: "1.0.0", Fixed: "1.5.0"}}},
			{Ecosystem: "npm", Package: "evil-mcp-tool", AdvisoryID: "MAL-2026-1", Aliases: []string{}, Kind: "malicious_package",
				Component: "mcp_package", Basis: "package_name", Rule: "name_token:mcp", Summary: "Malicious code in evil-mcp-tool",
				Ranges: []domain.MCPRange{{Introduced: "0"}}},
			{Ecosystem: "npm", Package: "candidate-mcp-server", AdvisoryID: "NOX-CAND-0007", Aliases: []string{}, Kind: "published_candidate",
				Component: "mcp_server", Basis: "package_name", Rule: "name_tokens:mcp+server", Summary: "Disclosed by a person",
				Ranges: []domain.MCPRange{}, VersionRange: ">=1.0 <1.3"},
		},
	}
	if err := f.Sign(priv, "test-key"); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	b, _ := json.MarshalIndent(f, "", "  ")
	_ = os.WriteFile(os.Args[1]+"/feed.json", b, 0o644)
	_ = os.WriteFile(os.Args[1]+"/pub.pem", []byte(slopfeed.EncodePublicKeyPEM(pub)), 0o644)
	fmt.Println("wrote", len(f.Entries), "entries; digest", f.Digest)
}
